message: feat(extensions): add Ori Manga and Gölge Bahçesi extensions

files.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
    <application
        android:label="Ori Manga"
        android:icon="@mipmap/ic_launcher">
        <meta-data
            android:name="tachiyomi.extension.class"
            android:value=".OriManga" />
    </application>
</manifest>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
    <application
        android:label="Gölge Bahçesi"
        android:icon="@mipmap/ic_launcher">
        <meta-data
            android:name="tachiyomi.extension.class"
            android:value=".GolgeBahcesi" />
    </application>
</manifest>
